text: A city council is debating whether to convert two lanes of a busy downtown street into a protected bike lane. Local business owners say they will lose customers; cycling advocates cite safety data.
A university announces that it will use an automated proctoring system for all remote exams. The system flags students based on eye movement and background noise.
A hospital adopts a triage algorithm that was trained on historical admissions data. Staff notice it recommends lower priority for patients from certain postal codes.
